description: Event discovery providers. A provider may only retrieve from the approved source it names (data/events/approved_sources.json): its URL must be on that source's domains, and every document it returns is checked against the same allow-list. 'entities' limits which companies the provider is used for; a company-newsroom feed is never used for other companies. No credentials belong in this file.

providers.label: NVIDIA Newsroom (RSS releases feed)
providers.note: Items that link to other hosts (for example blogs.nvidia.com) are listed as excluded: that host is not an approved source.

providers.label: Federal Register (official API)

location.basis: Issued by a United States federal agency (per the Federal Register's agency metadata). The document states no city, so the location is country-level.

providers.note: Full-text search of notices, rules and proposed rules. The evidence is the title and abstract the API returns.
